claim: BMS DC power is numerically kW-scale despite the source metadata label of W.
primary_metric: Median |VxI/1000|/|raw power| = 1.0016-1.0046 across 2017-2025; median raw-as-kW error about 0.18-0.46%; sign agreement about 100%.
supports: Use raw BMS power numerically as kW-scale after documenting the metadata inconsistency.

claim: Four published BMS cumulative-energy excerpts are consistent with temporary 16-bit high/low word swaps.
primary_metric: Each published pre->spike->pre excerpt returns within 1 s and the spike equals swap16(pre). Public locator is partial: annual source file + UTC time-of-day, not full UTC date.
supports: Raw cumulative counters require anomaly validation before throughput use.
does_not_support: A complete raw-window reproduction from the public package; a universal root cause; or assignment to a specific device/data layer.

claim: 2022-2024 observed throughput decline closely accompanies lower recorded command energy.
primary_metric: Actual absolute throughput 208.76->46.02 MWh (-78.0%); recorded command absolute energy 214.22->48.33 MWh (-77.4%); PQ-mode active hours 1349->587 h.
supports: The throughput decline alone does not establish an equivalent capacity-loss percentage and does not exclude concurrent degradation.
does_not_support: Why the upstream command itself declined, or that health-related limits played no role upstream.

claim: Within the observed common-condition, slow-ramp subset, tracking does not decline comparably to the 78% annual throughput reduction.
primary_metric: Bin-level table publishes support hours and projected tracking; 2023/2024 discharge 450-700 kW rows have only about 27 s/26 s and are not interpreted.
supports: Inside the selected operating envelope, observed command following does not show a comparable collapse.
does_not_support: Capability outside the envelope, full-range nameplate capability, absence of upstream derating, or absence of battery aging.

claim: A smaller discharge-side AC/DC/setpoint discrepancy remains after fine common-cell comparison.
primary_metric: For 200-450 kW: 23 common operating bins, 2.307 h support weight; AC tracking 0.9872->0.9726, DC/setpoint 0.9758->0.9442, derived mean-cell voltage 1.9647->1.9493 V. AC/DC >1 in both years.
supports: Further measurement-boundary / DC-side investigation is warranted.
does_not_support: Direct battery-loss attribution or efficiency inference.

claim: Common-condition-filtered field DCIR rises from 2022 to 2024.
primary_metric: Median string DCIR 86.82->90.19->99.90 mOhm; both transition directions show the same 2022->2024 increase.
supports: An apparent field string-path resistance-rise-consistent signal exists under the stated common filter and BSC measurement boundary.
does_not_support: A fully matched aging coefficient, isolated cell-internal ohmic resistance, direct capacity loss, or a unique mechanism.

claim: Pre-2022 historical coverage differs materially across BMS/BSC streams.
primary_metric: Published yearly usable-power hours, calendar-year fraction, and >5 s gap counts.
supports: Direct cross-stream annual comparisons require shared-interval or coverage-aware methods.
